reader_summary.headline: Hello and welcome to The Synopsis, a Speedwell Research podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to The Synopsis, a Speedwell Research podcast. I'm Drew Cohen, and this week on the synopsis, we will be reading one of our memos. If this is your first time listening to the synopsis, we have four different show formats.

key_points.text: We have in-depth company episodes where we focus on a single business drawing from Speedwall Research's in-depth research reports.
key_points.evidence_quote: We have in-depth company episodes where we focus on a single business drawing from Speedwall Research's in-depth research reports, which you can buy at Speedwall Research.com.

key_points.text: Our second episode, format is a dialogue podcast where we talk about various business and investing concepts.
key_points.evidence_quote: Our second episode, format is a dialogue podcast where we talk about various business and investing concepts.

key_points.text: Our third episode format are interviews.
key_points.evidence_quote: Our third episode format are interviews.

key_points.text: And what you are listening to right now is our fourth sort of episode, which is called an article podcast.
key_points.evidence_quote: And what you are listening to right now is our fourth sort of episode, which is called an article podcast, where we read our memo for those that prefer to listen to it instead of reading it.
